scripts.build: vue-tsc --noEmit && vite build && node -e "process.env.BUILD_MODE='lib'; require('child_process').execSync('vite build', { stdio: 'inherit', env: { ...process.env, BUILD_MODE: 'lib' } });" && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.copyFileSync('dist/widget.iife.js', '../web-dashboard/public/widget.js'); fs.copyFileSync('dist/widget.css', '../web-dashboard/public/widget.css'); console.log('Synced widget bundle to web-dashboard/public!');"
scripts.build:lib: vue-tsc --noEmit && node -e "process.env.BUILD_MODE='lib'; require('child_process').execSync('vite build', { stdio: 'inherit', env: { ...process.env, BUILD_MODE: 'lib' } });"
scripts.sync:dashboard: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.copyFileSync('dist/widget.iife.js', '../web-dashboard/public/widget.js'); fs.copyFileSync('dist/widget.css', '../web-dashboard/public/widget.css'); console.log('Synced widget bundle to web-dashboard/public!');"
